title: Asahina Mafuyu — A Warm Hand〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Kanade's Room

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (What happened that night...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I have to tell him next time...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Is something wrong...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Oh, no. It's nothing.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I'll be done with the lyrics soon, so if you don't mind taking a look...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Okay, sure.
The next day
Yoisaki Household - Kitchen

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hello. Thank you for having me over again today.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Thank you for coming, Ms. Mochizuki.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: So, about what we discussed yesterday...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, I brought over everything for the pot stickers! Making each one by hand should be very enjoyable.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: You requested pot stickers, Kanade?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Umm... Not quite...
I asked Ms. Mochizuki about dishes that the three of us could make together.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: You weren't feeling well yesterday, so I thought an activity like this would help take your mind off of things.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: So, would you like to make some with us...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: If everything's already been prepared, then I suppose...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Alright, I'll put the filling in a bowl.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Thank you for waiting.
Let's start wrapping these.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Okay.
Oh, Mafuyu, have you ever made pot stickers before?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Yes...
I made some with my mom and for home ec.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Right. I helped make some when I was little before, but I don't know about now...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Can I watch you two first?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Of course.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Asahina, these skins are for the regular pot stickers. And these are for the ones we'll be boiling.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Then, I'll start with the regular ones.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: You're really good at folding the edges, Mafuyu.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Really? I think I'm just okay...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Where should I put the ones that are wrapped?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: There should be a little plate next to you with potato starch on it. Please lightly dip the base of each one in it before placing them on the big plate.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Including the skins for the ones we're going to boil, there should just over thirty in total...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Mochizuki split them evenly into three piles, so we should only have to make about ten each...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I'll try making one now.
Let's see... First, place some of the filling onto the skin and...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I think that's a little too much, Kanade.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Really? Then, how about this...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Okay, the water comes next.
Oh, I think my hands are a little too wet now.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: That's okay, but you'll need to be gentle with the skins. The second they get stuck to your palms, they become easy to rip.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
(That's five...
It's nice how I don't have to think about anything else.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Although, I really should be studying instead of making these...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
M-Ms. Mochizuki, what do I do...?
The pot sticker skin is sticking to my fingers and palms now.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Hehe. Just a second.
Whenever that happens...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I think I'll keep doing this for a little while longer...)
